concerns.text: FR-008 and SC-005 require logging the percentage of subjects passing distinct session ID validation. Tasks T013b (calculate pass-rate), T013c (write excluded IDs), and T013d (verify metrics) are marked as unchecked/missing. Without these, the system cannot measure SC-005 or enforce the data integrity requirement of FR-008.

FR-002 requires extracting Ventral Striatum (VS) time series for all valid subjects, and FR-005 requires correlating flexibility with VS activation. Task T016b (calculate mean VS activation and write CSV) and T016d (verify CSV) are unchecked/missing. T016c only extracts the time series but does not aggregate it into the scalar metric required for the correlation analysis in US3.

FR-005 and FR-009 require correlation analysis on aligned data. Task T025b (filter VS activation CSV to match subjects after zero-variance exclusion) is unchecked/missing. Without this alignment step, the correlation analysis in T029 will fail or produce invalid results due to mismatched subject lists between flexibility scores and activation values.

FR-009 mandates a sensitivity analysis for window sizes {20, 30, 40} TRs and reporting results. Task T029b (implement sensitivity loop and write sensitivity_analysis.csv) is unchecked/missing. This leaves the robustness metric SC-003 unmeasurable and the requirement FR-009 unimplemented.

FR-010 requires failing fast if valid subjects < 50. Task T015 (fail fast logic) depends on T013b/T013c (metrics/exclusion logs) which are currently missing. The dependency chain is broken, preventing the implementation of the fail-fast requirement.

Task T041 is marked as unchecked (missing implementation) but is flagged as a 'run-book vs implementation' mismatch. While the task description exists, the lack of a concrete implementation plan (e.g., 'Create code/main.py' vs 'Update quickstart.md') makes it ambiguous how to resolve the stale tag/missing script issue. The task needs a specific action item to resolve the missing `code/main.py`.
